title: ServiceCurve deadline admission with stale-epoch fail-closed
hypothesis: For a bounded single-resource workload, current-epoch cumulative delivered service at the capability-use deadline is sufficient for analytic resource-feasibility admission, while stale service curves must not admit execution.
falsifiers: exhaustive discrete curves disagree with direct cumulative-sum oracle
equal-horizon-total front/back curves are treated as deadline-equivalent
stale forecast remains admissible when observed epoch changes
epoch-aware Monte Carlo produces any stale-forecast false admit
